News
OUAS joins exclusive research community
Østfold University of Applied Sciences (OUAS) has been admitted as a member of CAS – Centre for Advanced Study. This admission recognizes that the university college has significantly strengthened its research capacity over the past decade.
Introducing GAIYA at the OUAS AI Hub
The official launch of GAIYA is right around the corner and we were happy to present a "sneak peek" of the project to our colleagues at the Østfold University of Applied Sciences' (OUAS) AI Hub seminar.

Research
Parents' substance use raises the risk, but good parenting can break the pattern
Growing up in a home where parents drink or use drugs increases the likelihood that you will do the same. But new research shows this link can be disrupted, and that the most important factor is how parents actually engage with their children every day.
Bringing Viking ships back to life - one algorithm at a time
A PhD candidate at Østfold University College is creating a cutting-edge 3D visualization tool to create plausible interpretations of ancient Viking ships — and to show the world not just what we know about them, but also what we don't.
